insight_tenant_id.title: Insight Tenant ID
insight_tenant_id.description: Tenant isolation identifier stamped onto every emitted record.

insight_source_id.title: Insight Source ID
insight_source_id.description: Unique identifier for this connector instance (e.g., slack-main). Disambiguates workspaces in multi-workspace setups.

slack_bot_token.title: Slack User OAuth Token
slack_bot_token.description: Slack user OAuth token (xoxp-*) with admin.analytics:read scope. Slack's admin.analytics.getFile requires a user token — bot tokens (xoxb-*) are not supported. Token must be installed by an Org Owner/Admin. Plan must support Analytics API (Business+ or Enterprise Grid).

slack_start_date.title: Start Date
slack_start_date.description: Earliest analytics date to fetch (YYYY-MM-DD). Slack publishes snapshots with a ~2-day delay, so end of range is pinned to today - 2 days. Recommended: 14 days ago.
